title: RecoveryRecordPayload
description: Schema for Reed-Solomon Forward Error Correction (FEC) Recovery Record in TTZip

sliceSizeBytes.description: Byte size of each Cauchy RS shard

dataSlicesCount.description: Number of source data slices K

paritySlicesCount.description: Number of computed parity slices M

protectedPayloadLength.description: Total length of the payload protected by the recovery record

rootChecksum.description: SHA-256 or BLAKE3 root hash of the protected payload
